extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policymakers, and general readers seeking country reference profiles and infrastructure statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Reference-style country profiles (historical, political, economic notes) combined with a statistical table of 'Airports - with paved runways' giving per-country totals and runway-length category breakdowns with year estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country profile entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Each country entry provides a concise narrative summary: historical background (colonial history, independence dates), major political events and leadership, economic notes, social or human-rights concerns, and recent developments. Example entries include Ukraine (history from Kievan Rus to post-Soviet independence and Orange Revolution), Zimbabwe (independence, land redistribution, election issues), and many others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries are prose summaries intended as quick-reference overviews. They typically mention key dates, notable political regimes, major conflicts or upheavals, economic drivers, and current concerns. The page includes a 'last updated' date for currency (e.g., 'This page was last updated on 10 February, 2005'). Use these entries as high-level contextual background rather than exhaustive analysis; specific data points may have year annotations elsewhere on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports - with paved runways (runway length categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each country, the page lists the total number of airports with paved runways and a breakdown by runway-length categories: over 3,047 m; 2,438 to 3,047 m; 1,524 to 2,437 m; 914 to 1,523 m; and under 914 m. Each numeric entry is often accompanied by a year estimate in parentheses (e.g., '2004 est.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data is presented as per-country plain-text lines (e.g., 'United States — total: 5,128; over 3,047 m: 188; ... (2004 est.)'). Not all categories appear for every country (some categories may be omitted if zero or not reported). Treat the parenthetical year as the data's estimation year. This is a descriptive statistical metric useful for comparative infrastructure assessment across countries; verify year and sourcing when using for analysis.
